decisions.reason: As a close extension of the firm’s established dosimetry and QA offering in a growing market, Product A would likely be retained because there is no clear sign it falls below aspiration levels and the expanding firm has enough slack to continue learning from it.

Because Product B builds on the firm’s integrated oncology QA capabilities and supports its strategic move toward measurement, integration, automation, and prediction, management would likely keep it while results are still uncertain and organisational slack is available.
